ENGINEERING_BOM.question: show all active BOM's present
ENGINEERING_BOM.sql: SELECT MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code, MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Name, CASE WHEN MFC_M_BOM.Status = 2 THEN 'Active' WHEN MFC_M_BOM.Status = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Status FROM MFC_M_BOM WHERE MFC_M_BOM.Status = 2;

ENGINEERING_BOM.question: list out the bom along with its type
ENGINEERING_BOM.sql: SELECT MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code, MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Name, MFC_M_BOM_TYPE.BOM_Type_Name, CASE WHEN MFC_M_BOM.Status = 2 THEN 'Active' WHEN MFC_M_BOM.Status = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Status FROM MFC_M_BOM INNER JOIN MFC_M_BOM_TYPE ON MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Type_ID = MFC_M_BOM_TYPE.BOM_Type_ID;

ENGINEERING_BOM.question: Show all BOM versions along with their version numbers
ENGINEERING_BOM.sql: SELECT MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code, MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Name, MFC_L_BOM_VERSION.Version_Number, CASE WHEN MFC_L_BOM_VERSION.Status = 2 THEN 'Active' WHEN MFC_L_BOM_VERSION.Status = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Status FROM MFC_L_BOM_VERSION INNER JOIN MFC_M_BOM ON MFC_L_BOM_VERSION.BOM_ID = MFC_M_BOM.BOM_ID WHERE MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code IS NOT NULL;

ENGINEERING_BOM.question: Show BOM component quantities and UOM details
ENGINEERING_BOM.sql: SELECT MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code, MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Name, MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT.Item_ID AS Component_Item, MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT.Quantity, CAST(MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT.UOM_ID AS VARCHAR) AS UOM, CASE WHEN MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT.Status = 2 THEN 'Active' WHEN MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT.Status = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Status FROM MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT INNER JOIN MFC_M_BOM ON MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT.BOM_ID = MFC_M_BOM.BOM_ID WHERE MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code IS NOT NULL AND MFC_L_BOM_COMPONENT.Status = 2 ORDER BY MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code;

ENGINEERING_BOM.question: Find active alternative BOMs available in the system
ENGINEERING_BOM.sql: SELECT MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code, MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Name, MFC_L_BOM_ALTERNATIVE.Alternative_BOM_ID, CASE WHEN MFC_L_BOM_ALTERNATIVE.Status = 2 THEN 'Active' WHEN MFC_L_BOM_ALTERNATIVE.Status = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Status FROM MFC_L_BOM_ALTERNATIVE INNER JOIN MFC_M_BOM ON MFC_L_BOM_ALTERNATIVE.BOM_ID = MFC_M_BOM.BOM_ID WHERE MFC_L_BOM_ALTERNATIVE.Status = 2 AND MFC_M_BOM.BOM_Code IS NOT NULL;
